regions.quote: Type locality is '3 kilometers downstream of Thenmalai Dam, on Thenmalai-Trivandrum Road, Kallada River, Kerala, India', and it may be endemic to the Kallada system which flows through southern Kerala state before emptying into the coastal Ashtamudi Lake.
